payload.title: Report free baselines and published reference rows
payload.description:
## Purpose

Report free baselines so live arms are judged against what costs nothing.

## Scope

Refit-only on cached J0 answers (about 0.81), J0 twin-averaging, B-local kNN with masked keys, plus the published J0/J1/J2 reference rows (accuracy and flip rate) cited with their source.

## Definition of done

Rows on dev-100 and FINAL in the same summary format as the arms. Cost: $0.

## Links

[UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
